messages.body_plain:
Hi,

The dev branch of *rpy2* <https://twitter.com/hashtag/rpy2?src=hash> is now
mirrored on Git/Github: https://github.com/rpy2/rpy2
<https://t.co/S7gtPBpZfg> . With this, there is a Travis build script
checking that everything is fine on Linux and OS X.

Best,

L.
